tagline: Relationships between Unity Catalog metric views are in Beta.
what_it_does: Relationships between Unity Catalog metric views are in Beta. RELATIONSHIP to record how a source metric view joins to a target metric view, including the cardinality and the join condition, so that AI assistants and BI tools choose the right join path. Relationships require Databricks Runtime 19 and above, or a SQL warehouse.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
